mapper.sql: article_id, title, tag_name, author, published_time, tag_id, content, star, collection, comment, share, page_view, stick
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM a_article WHERE author = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO a_article (title, tag_name, author, published_time, tag_id, content, stick, star, collection, comment, share, page_view) VALUES (#{title}, #{tagName}, #{authorId}, NOW(), #{tagId}, #{content}, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE a_article SET page_view = page_view + 1 WHERE article_id = #{articleId}

choose.when: UPDATE a_article SET star = star + #{increment} WHERE article_id = #{articleId}
UPDATE a_article SET collection = collection + #{increment} WHERE article_id = #{articleId}
UPDATE a_article SET comment = comment + #{increment} WHERE article_id = #{articleId}
UPDATE a_article SET share = share + #{increment} WHERE article_id = #{articleId}

mapper.select: SELECT FROM a_article ORDER BY page_view DESC, published_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE a_article SET star = star + #{num} WHERE article_id = #{articleId}
UPDATE a_article SET collection = collection + #{num} WHERE article_id = #{articleId}
UPDATE a_article SET comment = comment + #{num} WHERE article_id = #{articleId}
UPDATE a_article SET share = share + #{num} WHERE article_id = #{articleId}
